title: Microsoft Teams: intelligent recap without saving a transcript
summary: Hold: the open question about automatic sensitivity labeling overlooks Microsoft's documented support for Word files stored in OneDrive. The feature's behavior, licensing, rollout and control paths are otherwise supported, but the PowerShell reference still disagrees with the feature article about whether two settings take effect.

claims.claim: MC1275312 was updated on 27 July 2026.
claims.quote: Updated July 27, 2026: We have updated the timeline.

claims.claim: The notice expected Targeted Release rollout from early October to mid-October 2026.
claims.quote: Targeted Release: We will begin rolling out early October 2026 (previously mid-August) and expect to complete by mid-October 2026 (previously late August).

claims.claim: The notice expected General Availability Worldwide rollout from mid-October to late October 2026.
claims.quote: General Availability (Worldwide): We will begin rolling out mid-October 2026 (previously late August) and expect to complete by late October 2026 (previously late September).

claims.claim: Microsoft positions this experience for organisations restricting transcript or recording retention for compliance reasons.
claims.quote: Intelligent recap without saving transcripts provides AI-generated meeting summaries for organizations that don't allow meeting transcripts or recordings, or that need to limit transcript and recording retention for compliance reasons.

claims.where: Why it matters; Open questions: organiser account deletion
claims.claim: The feature article does not describe summary behavior or continuing Recap access after the organiser's account is deleted.
claims.quote: Searched: intelligent recap summary organizer deleted OneDrive account. Read the feature article and OneDrive retention/deletion search excerpts; the latter describe general OneDrive cleanup, not continuing Teams Recap access.

claims.claim: The feature article does not describe how OneDrive sharing restrictions apply to these summaries.
claims.quote: Searched: intelligent recap without saving transcripts summary sensitivity labels and OneDrive. Read the complete feature article; it documents attendee access but not OneDrive sharing restrictions.

claims.claim: The feature article does not describe how sensitivity labels apply to summary documents.
claims.quote: Searched: AI summary OneDrive sensitivity labels auto-labeling recap. Read the complete feature article and the labeling references; the feature article itself contains no sensitivity-label guidance.

claims.claim: The feature article does not describe how DLP policies apply to summary documents.
claims.quote: Searched: intelligent recap without saving transcripts summary sensitivity labels and OneDrive. Read the complete feature article and SharePoint/OneDrive labeling guidance; the feature article itself contains no DLP guidance.

claims.claim: Sensitivity labeling for OneDrive files requires enabling and configuring the capability.
claims.quote: Enable built-in labeling for supported Office files and PDF files in SharePoint and OneDrive so that users can apply your sensitivity labels in Office for the web.

claims.claim: The feature guidance documents no separate meter for this experience at the time of writing in November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: intelligent recap without saving transcripts billing meter price. Read the complete feature guidance and general recap licensing excerpts; no separate meter is named in the feature guidance.

claims.claim: MC1275312 names the M365 Copilot (Premium) licence.
claims.quote: This feature will be available to users with an M365 Copilot (Premium) license across platforms

claims.claim: Copilot is an add-on licence prerequisite, supporting a medium cost rating rather than indirect cost only.
claims.quote: Prerequisites: An add-on Microsoft Copilot license for intended users.

claims.claim: Summary expiry is configured at Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Copilot and other AI > Set a default expiration time for Intelligent Recap .docx files for non-transcribed meetings.
claims.quote: Go to Meetings > Meeting policies. ... Select an existing policy or create a new one. ... Under Copilot and other AI, next to Set a default expiration time for Intelligent Recap .docx files for non-transcribed meetings, enter the number of days

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance guidance: At rollout; Governance controls: expiry row
claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy> -IntelligentRecapDocxFileExpirationDays 180 sets summary expiry to 180 days.
claims.quote: The following example sets the default expiration time to 180 days. Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policyname> -IntelligentRecapDocxFileExpirationDays 180
claims.fix: Add after the controls table: 'The feature article documents -IntelligentRecapDocxFileExpirationDays for expiry, but the Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy reference still says this feature has not been fully released and the setting will have no effect.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/powershell/module/microsoftteams/set-csteamsmeetingpolicy#-intelligentrecapdocxfileexpirationdays.

claims.where: controls[1].ui; Governance controls: intelligent recap row
claims.claim: An admin UI control for turning intelligent recap off while keeping Copilot is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams AllowIntelligentRecap turn off intelligent recap Teams admin center setting UI. Read feature guidance, Teams Premium overview search excerpts and Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy reference; the documented disabling route is PowerShell, not an admin UI.

claims.where: controls[1].api; Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls: intelligent recap row
claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy> -AllowIntelligentRecap $false turns off intelligent recap.
claims.quote: To turn off intelligent recap, use the Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy cmdlet and set the -AllowIntelligentRecap parameter to $false.
claims.fix: Add after the controls table: 'The feature article documents -AllowIntelligentRecap $false to disable recap, but the Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy reference still says this feature has not been fully released and the setting will have no effect.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/powershell/module/microsoftteams/set-csteamsmeetingpolicy#-allowintelligentrecap.

claims.claim: Turning intelligent recap off disables it for all meetings, whether or not transcripts are saved.
claims.quote: Turning off intelligent recap disables intelligent recap for all meetings, regardless of whether transcripts are saved.

claims.claim: The documented intelligent recap disabling route keeps Copilot enabled.
claims.quote: To prevent users from using this feature while keeping Copilot enabled, turn off intelligent recap in the Teams meeting policy.

claims.claim: The Copilot control is at Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Recording & transcription > Copilot.
claims.quote: Go to Meetings > Meeting policies. ... Select an existing policy or create a new one. ... Go to the Recording & transcription section and find the Copilot setting.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy> -Copilot Enabled configures Copilot in meetings and events.
claims.quote: To allow users to use Copilot Only during the meeting in meetings and events created by organizers with this policy: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -Copilot Enabled

claims.claim: EnabledWithTranscript is a documented Copilot parameter value and is the default.
claims.quote: On with saved transcript required | EnabledWithTranscript | This is the default value.

claims.claim: EnabledWithTranscriptDefaultOn is another Copilot parameter value on the cited Learn page.
claims.quote: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -Copilot EnabledWithTranscriptDefaultOn

claims.claim: Disabled is another Copilot parameter value on the cited Learn page.
claims.quote: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -Copilot Disabled

claims.claim: Copilot meeting policies can be applied to individual users.

claims.claim: The companion meeting memory feature is in preview.
claims.quote: Meeting memory is in preview and only available to organizations in the Teams TAP program.

claims.claim: Meeting memory is available only to organisations in the Teams TAP programme.
claims.quote: Meeting memory is in preview and only available to organizations in the Teams TAP program.

claims.claim: The default meeting memory expiration is five years, or 1,825 days.
claims.quote: The default expiration time for memory files is five years (1,825 days), but admins can customize the expiration time as needed for their organization.

claims.claim: Whether sensitivity labels can be automatically applied to the summary documents is an open documentation question.
claims.quote: Auto-labeling for SharePoint and OneDrive: PDF documents and Office files for Word (.docx), PowerPoint (.pptx), and Excel (.xlsx) are supported. These files can be auto-labeled at rest before or after the auto-labeling policies are created.
claims.fix: Remove the open question 'Whether sensitivity labels can be auto-applied to the summary documents.' Microsoft documents service-side auto-labeling for Word (.docx) files stored in OneDrive at https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/apply-sensitivity-label-automatically; summary documents are explicitly Word files in OneDrive.

claims.where: Scope; Open questions: Government cloud availability
claims.claim: Government cloud dates and availability for this specific experience are not published in the supplied record or feature guidance.
claims.quote: Searched: intelligent recap without saving transcripts government GCC availability. Read roadmap, MC1275312, feature guidance and search excerpts for Government Channel releases and general recap; none gives government dates for this specific experience.

claims.claim: The feature requires per-user Copilot entitlement rather than a tenant licence or a consumption entitlement.
claims.quote: Organizers in your organization with a Copilot license can generate the summary, and attendees in your organization who have a Copilot license can view it on the Recap tab after the meeting.
